correctness.rationale: Read the finite generator and verified row sums, irreducible sixteen-cycle, stationary phase π_j=1/16 and strictly positive λ_j=1+10^-3 cos(πj/8). Palm event phase α_j=π_j λ_j/λ̄ with λ̄=1. Duhamel expansion C=Q-I-εV gives S_t-S_e=ε²e^-u I(u)+E, |E|≤ε³e^-u u² e^{εu}/2, I=1/2∫_0^u e^{-(1-cos π/8)s} cos(s sin π/8)ds. At u*=3π/(2sin π/8), the exact Fourier integral I=(1-e^{-3πtan(π/16)/2}/tan(π/16))/4<-1/6, while εu*²e^{εu*}/2<169/1974<1/6. The strict negative gap follows; derivative at zero is ε²/2>0. Independent 55-digit matrix exponential and analytic inequalities (nine checks) independently yielded S_t(u*)-S_e(u*)≈-1.08728715778341885e-12. This magnitude is tiny and numerical subtraction was not used as a proof.
residual_risks: No claim about squared coefficient of variation (conjecture III) or orders outside this explicit 16-state example.
The negative difference is small, requiring analytic signed error bounds rather than conventional floating-point certification.

originality.rationale: The full Asanjarani–Nazarathy 2022 paper frames time-stationary stochastic dominance over event-stationary as Conjecture 3.9 (statement IV) for general MMPPs; its proven regimes are MSPPs and two-state MMPPs and its four-phase example concerns nonmonotonic hazard rate rather than failure of the waiting-time order. The earlier 2018 arXiv:1802.08400 abstract says an associated stochastic order was proved, whereas the authors later call the general order conjectural. Its full text could not be accessed; this inconsistency is material, not dismissed. The explicitly checked strict counterexample is logically incompatible with any valid universal dominance theorem, so a purported earlier universal proof does not establish strong factual coverage of the counterexample itself. A prior example may still exist.
residual_risks: arxiv:1802.08400 is a directly relevant but full-text inaccessible same-author precursor whose abstract claims an associated stochastic ordering; cannot exclude overlap or resolve conflict from abstract alone.
The earlier article is not treated as retracted, wrong, or read in full; no invented priority conclusion.

value.rationale: A rigorous explicit counterexample to a published universal stochastic-order conjecture is scientifically consequential even when the system has only sixteen phases. The Fourier-mode construction explains the mechanism (nonreversible oscillatory modulation) and provides a verifiable analytic sign margin independent of fragile numerical subtraction.
residual_risks: The counterexample does not resolve conjecture III about event-interval squared coefficient of variation.

final_claim: An irreducible cyclic sixteen-phase MMPP with rates 1+10^-3 cos(πj/8) violates the conjectured universal stochastic order S_time≥S_event at u*=3π/(2sin(π/8)), while the opposite inequality holds sufficiently near zero.
limitations: The sign crossing concerns the waiting-time stochastic order (IV), not the separate squared-CV assertion (III).
The earlier 2018 same-author manuscript was not fully accessible; abstract conflicts with the 2022 conjecture.
